expectations.criterion: Rejects or corrects the warm scenario until a bounded precondition verifies the intended process and UI state before the trigger.
expectations.evidence: Declares the matrix not ready, adds a precondition verifying the live process and intended UI state, requires explicit foreground/background state, and bounds the precondition to 60 seconds.

expectations.criterion: Produces a version 2 matrix using context.provider and requires a successful runner dry run after resolving placeholders.
expectations.evidence: Provides matrix_version 2 with context.provider and explicit lifecycle hooks; requires replacing every placeholder and obtaining dry-run exit status 0 with status planned.

expectations.criterion: Requires the dry-run plan and target plus installed-app preflight without claiming unavailable checks ran.
expectations.evidence: Requires emulator readiness, installed flavor application identity verification, and review of redacted preflight and scenario commands before execution. Explicitly states no commands were run.

expectations.criterion: Bounds the warm precondition with the per-step timeout and places idempotent cleanup in finally-backed after hooks across all outcomes.
expectations.evidence: Requires every hook, including precondition, to inherit the 60-second timeout and after to run from finally after success, failure, timeout, or command error, with idempotent cleanup.

expectations.criterion: Reports the target using a safe label rather than exposing its raw identifier by default.
expectations.evidence: Sets target_label to notification-test-emulator and include_device_id to false; requests redacted preflight review.

judgment.summary: The response explicitly satisfies all five criteria while correctly withholding execution and distinguishing required checks from completed verification.
